$comment: Shared decision-support vectors (web: lib/pane-engine/src/__tests__/decision.test.ts; iOS: ios/AmiseMedFlowTests/TreatmentDecisionTests.swift). Generated by scripts/src/gen-decision-vectors.ts — regenerate only after a deliberate content change and review the diff.

vectors.description: Fit 45-year-old, confirmed acute cholecystitis: early laparoscopic cholecystectomy ranks first.
Frail 88-year-old (CFS 7, ASA IV, eGFR 28): drainage over early laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

options.factorSummary: Frailty CFS 7, ASA IV and Age 88 raised the harm of percutaneous cholecystostomy (gallbladder drainage) (treat threshold 44% → 76%).
Frailty CFS 7, ASA IV and Age 88 raised the harm of early laparoscopic cholecystectomy (treat threshold 50% → 100%).

vectors.description: Cholecystitis 40% (engine), not confirmed: test further (ultrasound).
Cholecystitis at 6% (below the 10% floor) is not a leading diagnosis: no decision.
Fit adult, confirmed appendicitis: appendicectomy ranks above antibiotics-first.
Pregnant 28 weeks: antibiotics-first benefit lowered, operative harm raised.

options.factorSummary: Pregnant raised the harm of laparoscopic appendicectomy (treat threshold 63% → 69%).
Pregnant lowered the benefit of antibiotics-first (non-operative) (treat threshold 52% → 60%).

vectors.description: Appendicolith on CT lowers the antibiotics-first benefit.

options.factorSummary: Appendicolith on imaging lowered the benefit of antibiotics-first (non-operative) (treat threshold 52% → 59%).

vectors.description: Fit adult, uncomplicated diverticulitis: observe (no routine antibiotics, outpatient).
Immunosuppressed and penicillin-allergic: antibiotics now indicated (non-penicillin regimen), admission favoured.

options.factorSummary: Penicillin allergy recorded raised the harm of antibiotics; Immunosuppressed raised the benefit of antibiotics (treat threshold 100% → 34%).
Immunosuppressed raised the benefit of hospital admission (treat threshold 100% → 40%).

vectors.description: Wells PE 3 (unlikely): pre-test 12%, test further; no thrombolysis.
Confirmed PE with shock 5 days after surgery: thrombolysis not for this patient (ESC 2019), anticoagulation harm raised.

options.factorSummary: Surgery within 21 days raised the harm of therapeutic anticoagulation (treat threshold 28% → 38%).
Surgery within 21 days: systemic thrombolysis is not for this patient.

vectors.description: Confirmed PE with shock on warfarin + aspirin, eGFR 25: thrombolysis stays a treat option with raised harm; anticoagulation harm raised.

options.factorSummary: eGFR 25, HAS-BLED 3 and On antiplatelet therapy raised the harm of therapeutic anticoagulation (treat threshold 28% → 57%).
On an oral anticoagulant and On antiplatelet therapy raised the harm of systemic thrombolysis; Shock (SBP 84) raised the benefit of systemic thrombolysis (treat threshold 100% → 93%).

vectors.description: Caprini 1: mechanical prophylaxis; LMWH observe.
Caprini 6: LMWH with mechanical prophylaxis ranks first.
Caprini 6 on a DOAC: prophylactic LMWH not for this patient.

options.factorSummary: On therapeutic anticoagulation: pharmacological prophylaxis (LMWH) with mechanical prophylaxis is not for this patient.

vectors.description: Glasgow-Blatchford 1: outpatient management (observe).

decisions.chip: GBS 1 → 0.4% risk of needing intervention or death

vectors.description: Glasgow-Blatchford 13 with shock: admit, endoscopy within 12 h after resuscitation.

decisions.chip: GBS 13 → 70% risk of needing intervention or death

options.factorSummary: Shock (SBP 86) raised the benefit of endoscopy within 12 h (after resuscitation) (treat threshold 100% → 9.1%).

vectors.description: Upper GI bleed without a Glasgow-Blatchford score: risk unknown, calculate the score.

missing: Calculate the Glasgow-Blatchford score to set the risk.

vectors.description: Possible sepsis 30%, no shock: observe (rapid assessment, antibiotics within 3 h if concern persists).
Possible sepsis 30% with lactate 5: antibiotics within 1 h (treat); lactate result action.

options.factorSummary: Shock (lactate 5) raised the benefit of IV antibiotics within 1 hour (treat threshold 33% → 14%).

vectors.description: Warfarin for AF before surgery: no bridging (BRIDGE).
Warfarin with a mechanical valve before surgery: bridging (borderline).

decisions.chip: thromboembolic risk during the interruption 5% (Mechanical heart valve (high thromboembolic risk; weighted for valve thrombosis — estimate))

vectors.description: DOAC before surgery: bridging not for this patient (PAUSE).

options.factorSummary: On a DOAC (not warfarin): bridging with therapeutic-dose LMWH is not for this patient.

vectors.description: Perforated ulcer, age 84, CFS 6, eGFR 28: laparotomy harm raised, borderline.

options.factorSummary: Age 84, Frailty CFS 6 and eGFR 28 raised the harm of emergency laparotomy (treat threshold 14% → 77%).

vectors.description: Gallstone pancreatitis, Glasgow-Imrie 4, lipase 1450: same-admission cholecystectomy deferred; lipase result action.

resultActions.thresholdText: lipase >= 3 x the upper limit of normal (ULN 60 U/L assumed — use the local reference range)

options.factorSummary: Predicted severe pancreatitis (Glasgow-Imrie, BISAP or Ranson >= 3): same-admission laparoscopic cholecystectomy is not for this patient.

vectors.description: Mild gallstone pancreatitis: same-admission cholecystectomy (PONCHO).

resultActions.thresholdText: lipase >= 3 x the upper limit of normal (ULN 60 U/L assumed — use the local reference range)

vectors.description: Confirmed "severe acute biliary pancreatitis" without a severity score: same-admission cholecystectomy deferred (revised Atlanta).

missing: Record BMI (height and weight) to refine: BMI 40 or more raises operative harm (same-admission laparoscopic cholecystectomy).

options.factorSummary: Predicted severe pancreatitis (Glasgow-Imrie, BISAP or Ranson >= 3): same-admission laparoscopic cholecystectomy is not for this patient.

vectors.description: A confirmed diagnosis wins: the engine's sepsis differential (30%) gives no decision.
Fit 50-year-old man, inguinal hernia: repair.
Frail 86-year-old man (CFS 7): watchful waiting.

options.factorSummary: Frailty CFS 7, Age 86 and ASA III raised the harm of elective inguinal hernia repair (treat threshold 20% → 100%).

vectors.description: Score and result actions only: CURB-65 3, NEWS2 single red parameter, K 6.8, Hb 65, troponin 40, amylase superseded by lipase.

resultActions.thresholdText: lipase >= 3 x the upper limit of normal (ULN 60 U/L assumed — use the local reference range)
troponin above the assay's 99th-centile upper reference limit (ULN 14 ng/L assumed — use the local reference range)

vectors.description: Local ULN: lipase 400 with ULN 160 is below 3 x ULN; troponin 40 with URL 50 is not raised.

missing: Record eGFR to refine: eGFR below 30 raises operative and anticoagulant harm (pharmacological prophylaxis (LMWH) with mechanical prophylaxis).
